landing.step_01_desc: Upload, browse or photograph a clear crop leaf.

landing.step_04_desc: Combine diagnosis with live environmental conditions.

landing.feature_4_desc: Integrates real temperature, humidity, rainfall and wind telemetry.
landing.feature_5_desc: Connects disease context with environmental conditions.
landing.feature_6_desc: Converts analysis into immediate action, prevention and monitoring.
